low_hp_warning: Critical: I feel like I'm dying
hp_snapshot_hint: Not your current HP. Rest at a campfire to refresh this.
panel_dock_tooltip: Dock to the screen edge (click the edge tab to restore)
panel_hint_default: Drag the title bar to move · changes apply instantly
panel_hint_salt: Fixed: garbling never changes; Chaos: re-rolled on every launch
panel_hint_blur: Garbling level for all text (0% readable, exemptions aside)
panel_hint_selection: Randomly reveal some card faces in reward screens (fixed per reward)
panel_hint_shop_event: Show real card faces for cards from shops and events
panel_hint_memory_omniscient: Omniscience: every card is revealed everywhere
panel_hint_memory_good: Good memory: playing a card reveals it for the run, including its copies in rewards/shops/events
panel_hint_memory_bad: Bad memory: a copy drawn n times without being played reverts to unknown
panel_hint_memory_fade: Cards still unrevealed at the end of a combat are removed from the deck (nonsense mode exempt)
panel_hint_play_counter: Count plays per copy (same-name copies numbered by joining order) and show a top-right leaderboard
panel_hint_enemy_models: Show real enemy models (default off: breathing boxes only)
panel_hint_amnesia_status: HP and gold stay at the values from your last rest (shown gray)
panel_hint_status_numbers: HP and gold numbers are no longer garbled (live/amnesia mode unchanged)
panel_hint_map_routes: Show every map node and route
panel_hint_intent: Enemy intents: hidden / first round only / every round
panel_hint_reset: Restore every modifier option to its default
panel_hint_relics: Restore every relic display: owned, rewards, shops, chests, inspect (compendium already visible)
